title: Higgsfield AI Launches Free Hosted MCP Connector for Claude: 1080p Seedance Video Generation in Chat
summary: Higgsfield announced a hosted Model Context Protocol connector linking Claude and ChatGPT directly to Seedance 2.0, Nano Banana Pro, and ElevenLabs audio with 72-hour unlimited free access.
content:
Higgsfield AI has released its hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, enabling Claude Desktop, claude.ai, and ChatGPT users to generate cinema-grade 1080p video, 2K photorealistic images, and studio voiceovers directly within their chat conversations.

### The Model Context Protocol Revolution
By utilizing Anthropic's open Model Context Protocol standard over HTTP (`https://mcp.higgsfield.ai/mcp`), users no longer need to switch tabs or wrangle complex API billing keys. Claude can directly invoke Higgsfield's generation pipeline as a native tool, returning rendered MP4 video clips and high-resolution visuals directly in the chat stream.

### 72-Hour Free & Unlimited Access
To celebrate the arrival of Claude Fable 5.2 on Higgsfield, the company announced a limited-time 72-hour unlimited free trial ($0 upfront) giving unrestricted access to:
• **Video Generation**: Seedance 2.0 (1080p HD, 15s), Seedance 2.5 (480p, 30s long-form), and Seedance 2.0 Fast.
• **Image Generation**: Nano Banana Pro (2K), Seedream 5.5, and GPT Image 2.6.
• **Audio Synthesis**: Seed Audio 1.0, Eleven v3, and Minimax Speech 2.8 HD.

Developers can configure the connector in Claude Desktop via Settings > Connectors, or in Claude Code CLI by running: `claude mcp add --transport http higgsfield https://mcp.higgsfield.ai/mcp`.
